credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Four (4) color card paint samples arranged in layers, laminated together,  representing an array of yellow and orange hues. Handwritten in pencil are color notations.  On the recto is written, " Cad Deep, 2/53 Holland and on the verso is written Cad. Middle Holland, 2/53. Each color test was executed on an individual square of cardboard or heavy paper.  The squares, about 3" on average, present individual samples of saturated color.
title: Color Cards, Shades of Cadmium
